articles.title: MetaMask launches Money Account with stablecoin yield and spending in one wallet
articles.snippet: The launch reflects a broader push to make stablecoins more useful beyond trading and transfers.

articles.title: Strategy heads for 11th losing month in 12 as bitcoin weakness continues
articles.snippet: Strategy (MSTR) shares have lost around 41% of their value in June.

articles.title: Business use of stablecoins set for growth surge: Cybrid report
articles.snippet: The majority of businesses surveyed are likely to use stablecoins within the next 12 months, while regulatory clarity remained the biggest barrier to wider adoption.

articles.title: MetaMask launches stablecoin yield account with card spending
articles.snippet: MetaMask launches Money Account it says offers up to 4% variable APY on mUSD stablecoin balances and card spending, with DeFi-powered yield via vaults, excluding the UK and sanctioned jurisdictions.

articles.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK adds $43.5M in crypto stocks amid market dip
articles.snippet: ARK Invest's biggest crypto stock purchases over the past three trading days were Coinbase and Circle, whose shares have fallen 17% and 27.6%, respectively, over the past month.
